title: Hello Goodbye
lyrics:
She walked away with grace but I stood still
Now there's someone new who fits the bill
A dance of chance in a world so grand
Got to keep my heart in my own hand
She said goodbye but a door it swung wide
Found a love where my heart could never hide
In the ink of night a morning came too
The sun it knows what the heart should do
Good will find good this story is true
The key to love is inside of you
Don't pass it down to just anyone
Love will shine like the morning sun
Held that key thought it slipped away
Found it again in the light of day
Life's a melody with highs and lows
Got to trust where the river flows
In the darkest hour a new dawn breaks
Hearts may tremble but the earth still shakes
It's the dance of life a beautiful show
Keep your heart where the true winds blow
Good will find good this story is true
The key to love is inside of you
Don't pass it down to just anyone
Love will shine like the morning sun
